## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)

- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to change)

## Related issue

<!-- Link to the issue this PR addresses, if any (e.g., "Closes #42") -->

## Checklist

### All PRs

- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional commits
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the unreleased section
- [ ] CI is green

### Code changes

- [ ] Type hints on public functions
- [ ] Docstrings on public functions and classes
- [ ] Unit tests cover new behavior
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] `seed=151` preserved in any new random operations

### Notebook changes

- [ ] Notebook runs top-to-bottom without errors
- [ ] Outputs cleared before commit
- [ ] Narrative matches corresponding textbook chapter

### Textbook content

- [ ] Math notation matches Appendix A conventions
- [ ] Every new concept has intuition, formal definition, and worked example
- [ ] New terms added to glossary (Appendix D)
- [ ] Citations are real papers
- [ ] LaTeX compiles cleanly
